explanation: That which is true and unchangeable; Jesus calls himself "the way, the truth, and the life" and says that his words reveal reality about God.
Liberation from the power of sin and the judgment of death; Jesus promises to give this freedom to those who hold fast to his teaching.
Breaking God's will or living in opposition to him; John 8 describes how all people are bound by sin if they do not believe in Christ.
The symbol for Jesus himself, who gives revelation and guidance in the darkness; he says that his words shine light on the truth about human states of mind.
God the Father, the source of all life and love; Jesus emphasizes his unique connection with him against those who do not recognize this relationship.
The father of the Jewish people; in the chapter, Jesus discusses how Abraham believed God's promise, while his descendants now refuse to see the truth about the Messiah.
The eternal separation from God that is the result of sin; Jesus warns that those who do not believe will die in their sins.
